description: Indexer ReLU forms that keep a NaN (isnan, ne, sel) against r6k's kernel: bits on finite inputs, time per call in three alternating rounds, the indexer tests and NaN contract per variant; the shared SwiGLU and Engram gate fixes re-timed the same way.
argv: import os, subprocess, sys; codes = [subprocess.call([sys.executable, '/b/bench_relu.py'])]; env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH='/b' + os.pathsep + os.environ.get('PYTHONPATH', '')); codes += [subprocess.call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '--noconftest', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '-p', 'variant_plugin', '-rfEPxX', '-k', 'indexer', 'tests/kernels/attention/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang.py'], env=dict(env, VARIANT=v)) for v in ('isnan', 'ne', 'sel')]; print('exit codes (bench, isnan, ne, sel)', codes); sys.exit(max(codes))
